name: hhv-sidecar
//camoufox-js: Pinned to an exact version on purpose, NOT a range. 0.11.2 ships a
fingerprint generator that sets an audio:seed property our pinned
not know, and every session creation dies with UnknownProperty.
On 02.11.2026 an `npm update` rewrote this pin to "^0.8.2" -- three
minor versions BACKWARDS -- and committed a lockfile to match, which
then broke `npm ci` in the image build against the still-pinned
package.json. npm may rewrite ranges in package.json; after every
update read `git diff package.json` before committing.
//overrides: Forces versions onto packages that bring their own copy along.
adm-zip: ours is already 0.6, but camoufox-js and
generative-bayesian-network each install a 0.5.18 of their own beneath
themselves (CVE-2026-39244, DoS via a crafted ZIP). The override is the
only lever that reaches a nested dependency.
browserslist: CVE-2026-73088/73089, prototype pollution and unbounded
memory growth. brace-expansion: CVE-2026-14257/69152, both DoS.
Whenever one of these disappears from the Trivy report on its own
because the parent package has caught up, the entry here can go.
